description: Live policy dispatch and durable control seams

live_policy_evaluator.role: Actor-owned pure policy evaluator. configure(digest, rule), activate_emergency_deny(), evaluate(ticket, pinned, input_bytes, taint) -> DecisionRecord.

policy_core_types.role: DecisionCode, PolicyRule, PolicyDigest, DecisionRecord, PinnedAdmissionPolicy, CurrentLivePolicy, InfluenceState.

registered_executor.role: execute_registered_action() and reconcile_registered_action(). Missing: policy evaluation before adapter.execute().

runtime_struct.role: Runtime struct with policy: vb_core::policy::RuntimePolicy (durability). Missing: live_policy: LivePolicy field.

runtime_journal_trait.role: RuntimeJournalEvent enum and RuntimeJournal trait (append, append_sequenced, append_sequenced_batch, convert_to_storage_event).

journal_event_mapping.role: convert_to_storage_event() mapping from RuntimeJournalEvent to vb_storage::JournalEvent.

registered_action_context.role: registered_action_context() returns RegisteredActionContext with admitted artifact — source for admitted policy pin.

execution_binding.role: validate() verifies execution tuple against accepted artifact.

fjall_adapter.role: FjallRegister::execute(grant, ticket, value) and reconcile(). Calls grant.validate(ticket) internally.

accepted_artifact.role: AcceptedArtifact struct with policy_digest field. compute_policy_digest(&CompiledWorkflow).

storage_child.role: Full stable DecisionRecord storage API (tag38, frozen production1a231a9f). Provides PolicyDecisionEvent wire format.

admission_pin_child.role: Repairing AcceptedArtifact.policy_digest admission/recovery. Must complete before this contract can use the actual admitted pin.
